notes.title: Dark Moon
notes.content: An ancient battleship appeared nearby a planet with a dark moon. He will attack all ships. Use his power to gain an advantage on the battlefield and defeat much stronger opponents.

notes.title: Dark Moon
notes.content: An ancient starship set up a base nearby planet with a dark moon. He will attack every ship that enters his space. Use him to gain an advantage on the battlefield and defeat much stronger opponents.
